tools.name: ask
tools.description: Answer a free-text Dubai property question (e.g. '2 bed off-plan in Dubai Hills under 3M handover 2027'). Parses community, developer, bedrooms, price, stage, handover year and type, then returns schema.org-typed results with mrk.ae URLs.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search ~2,400 Dubai residential projects (DLD-registered plus MRK-researched new launches). Filter by community, developer, stage, handover year, starting-price range, bedrooms and type. Returns compact summaries with canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full facts for one project by slug or exact name: developer, community, status, handover, starting prices by unit type, payment plan, highlights, considerations and cited sources.

tools.name: compare_projects
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 5 projects by slug: developer, community, stage, handover, starting price, unit types, payment plan.

tools.name: list_developers
tools.description: List Dubai developers with project counts (off-plan vs ready), optionally filtered by name text. Sorted by project count.

tools.name: get_developer
tools.description: Developer profile: project count, off-plan/ready split, communities, starting-price statistics and its top projects.

tools.name: list_communities
tools.description: List Dubai communities with project counts and lowest starting price, optionally filtered by name text. Sorted by project count.

tools.name: get_community
tools.description: Community stats: project count, off-plan/ready split, developers, starting-price bands (lowest/median/highest) and top projects.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search MRK Real Estate's live sale listings (from the MRK CRM, refreshed every 5 minutes). Filter by text, location, type, price and bedrooms.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details of one live MRK sale listing by web slug or reference.

tools.name: calculate_purchase_costs
tools.description: Itemised one-off costs of buying in Dubai using MRK's verified fee schedule: DLD 4% transfer fee, DLD admin fee, title deed, registration trustee fee (+VAT), mortgage registration, agency commission (+VAT) and developer NOC range.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Monthly repayment, total interest and loan-to-value for a repayment mortgage. Pure arithmetic on the rate you supply; UAE Central Bank base rate is returned for context only, not as a quote.

tools.name: rental_yield_estimate
tools.description: ESTIMATE of gross and net rental yield from a price and an annual rent you supply (plus optional service charge and other annual costs). MRK does not supply the rent figure; result is labelled as an estimate.

tools.name: golden_visa_eligibility
tools.description: Indicative check against the UAE 10-year Golden Visa real-estate route (property value of at least AED 2 million). Returns shortfall and conditions to confirm with ICP / GDRFA Dubai.

tools.name: search_insights
tools.description: Search MRK's sourced Dubai market insights (original commentary with linked sources). Filter by text and category.

tools.name: get_insight
tools.description: Full insight article by slug: summary, key numbers with sources, body sections, FAQs and source list.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Send a buyer/seller enquiry to MRK Real Estate's advisory team on the user's behalf. Only call with the user's explicit consent. Requires name plus email or phone. Rate limited.

tools.name: search_glossary
tools.description: Search the MRK Dubai real estate glossary for a term definition. Returns matching terms with definitions.

tools.name: get_dubai_community_facts
tools.description: Get key facts about a Dubai community including price per sqft, rental yield and Golden Visa qualifying status.

tools.name: calculate_dld_buying_costs
tools.description: Calculate Dubai Land Department transfer fees and total buying costs for a Dubai property purchase.

tools.name: check_golden_visa_eligibility
tools.description: Check if a Dubai property investment qualifies for UAE Golden Visa (10-year residency). Minimum threshold is AED 2 million.

tools.name: get_rent_cap_increase
tools.description: Calculate the maximum legal rent increase in Dubai per RERA Decree 43/2013 rent cap tiers based on how far current rent is below market average.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_projects · Public sink: submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_projects · Public sink: submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
